prompt:
You are answering from the following product documentation excerpt.

Documentation: Invoices are generated within 48 hours of shipment confirmation and sent to the billing contact on file. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 14 business days of approval. Accounts more than 30 days overdue accrue a late fee of 1.5% per month on the outstanding balance. Gold-tier support includes a 4-hour response SLA during business hours, while Standard-tier requests are answered within 2 business days. Plan downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing cycle and are not prorated.

Question: A Gold-tier customer asks when their approved refund will arrive and what happens if their account becomes overdue. What does the documentation say?
key_points: refund window 14 business days to original payment method
late fee 1.5% per month after 30 days overdue
downgrades effective end of billing cycle, not prorated
